# Petkit feeder and litter box (`petkit`)

The Petkit D4 feeder and T4 litter box, through Petkit's cloud. Unofficial: it presents itself as Petkit's app and can break when Petkit changes its servers.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/petkit`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/petkit/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/petkit/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | Petkit's cloud, not documented for third parties |
| Classes | `feeder`, `litter` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | no |
| Guided setup | yes |

**Petkit does not document this API for third parties.** It can change or stop working at any time, and using it may be against the vendor's terms.

## What it reaches

- HTTPS to `passport.petkt.com`
- HTTPS to `api.petkt.com`
- HTTPS to `api.eu-pet.com`
- HTTPS to `api.petktasia.com`
- HTTPS to `api.petkit.cn`

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `region` | Region | text, at most 32 | yes |  | Your country as the Petkit app has it, such as DE, or china. |
| `timezone` | Time zone | text, at most 64 | no | `UTC` | An IANA name, sent to Petkit as the time zone of this account. |
| `utc_offset_minutes` | Minutes east of UTC | whole number, -840 to 840 | no | `0` | For that zone, now. The date of a feed and the time shown for the last one use it. It does not follow daylight saving time by itself. |
| `commands` | Commands | true or false | no | `false` | Feeding and cleaning are refused until this is on, so the readings can be checked against the real devices first. |
| `feeder_id` | Feeder id | whole number, 1 to 9223372036854775807 | no |  | Only needed when the account has more than one feeder. The setup fills it in. |
| `litter_id` | Litter box id | whole number, 1 to 9223372036854775807 | no |  | Only needed when the account has more than one litter box. The setup fills it in. |
| `poll_secs` | Reading kept for (s) | whole number, 15 to 600 | no | `60` | How often a reading is fetched from Petkit when nothing was just commanded. |
| `passport_url` | Passport address | URL (https, http) | no | `https://passport.petkt.com/` | Where Petkit lists its regional servers. Only a test changes this. |
| `app_version` | App version | text, at most 64 | no | `13.2.1` | The version of Petkit's app the hub says it is. Change it only if Petkit starts refusing this one. |
| `user_agent` | User agent | text, at most 200 | no | `okhttp/3.14.9` | The app's HTTP client, as the hub presents it. |
| `os_version` | Android version | text, at most 64 | no | `16.1` | Of the phone the hub says the app runs on. |
| `phone_model` | Phone model | text, at most 64 | no | `23127PN0CG` | Of the phone the hub says the app runs on. |
| `phone_brand` | Phone brand | text, at most 64 | no | `Xiaomi` | Of the phone the hub says the app runs on. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `login` | Account login | yes | The account, a colon, and the MD5 of its sign-in secret in hex, on one line. The setup writes it. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.

## Words for voice

- Heard `pet feeder`, meant `petkit feeder`
- `petkit` names the class `feeder`
